name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated Resource of 199 million ounces of silver and 1.7 million ounces of gold, and has completed a Pre-Feasibility Study along with receiving its Environmental Impact Assessment approval from Salta provincial authorities in April 2026. The company is advancing toward a Definitive Feasibility Study and construction, supported by RIGI approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime.
